application_summary: The application is the Google homepage, allowing users to perform searches, access Google services like Gmail and Images, change language preferences, and view legal and corporate information.
important_flows: Search functionality using the textarea and submit buttons

journeys.title: Perform a basic search
journeys.description: User navigates to Google homepage, enters a search query into the search box, and submits the search.
preconditions: User is on the Google homepage

journeys.title: Navigate to Sign in page
journeys.description: User clicks the Sign in button from the Google homepage header.
preconditions: User is on the Google homepage
journeys.expected_result: User is directed to the Google accounts service login page.
